note: AgentRisk defines its own simple, redistributable classification taxonomy. It is deliberately NOT GICS (which is proprietary and cannot be shipped). Theme-tag membership is subjective by design; this file is the transparent, reviewable source of truth. Callers can override any classification per position.

tags.ai: Companies whose valuation is materially driven by artificial-intelligence products, models, or infrastructure.
tags.semiconductors: Designers or manufacturers of semiconductor chips and related equipment.
tags.ev: Electric-vehicle manufacturers and closely tied suppliers.
tags.biotech: Biotechnology and drug-development companies with clinical/pipeline risk.
tags.defense: Aerospace and defense contractors with material government-defense revenue.
tags.energy-transition: Renewable energy, clean power, and decarbonization companies.
tags.crypto: Direct crypto assets or instruments whose value tracks crypto assets.
tags.broad-market: Diversified index or broad-market exchange-traded funds.
